correctness.rationale: Exact substitution of the Toeplitz Green entries into the BPF recurrence yields the delta source and outgoing boundary conditions. The two homogeneous waves prove uniqueness for 0<s<pi. Unit-modulus entries give the Frobenius norm. Hermitian second-order simple-eigenvalue perturbation with polynomially evaluated finite sums gives lambda_2=-(m^2-1)(2m^2+7)/45 and the sharp norm curvature. The verified script also checks 127 finite-sum orders, 80 exact-system comparisons and 35 asymptotic numerical probes. Numerical checks are supplementary, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original published BPF bound grows as a second-order Nyquist pole for fixed mesh size, whereas the true sharp source-only amplification is first order with explicit physical coefficient and mesh-dependent curvature. This replaces a conservative stability bound by a sharp reliability benchmark for the named phase-fitted scheme. The result is an exact finite-grid/source invariant with a motivated near-resonance role, not a stand-alone arbitrary calculation; no general PDE or floating-point claim is made.
